newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: IRSA, Parque Arauco buy Argentine mall for $54 mln.
newsitem.headline: IRSA, Parque Arauco buy Argentine mall for $54 mln.

text.p: SAMAP, a developer controlled by Argentine real state company IRSA and Chile's Parque Arauco, said Tuesday it bought local shopping Paseo Alcorta for $54 million.
The contract was signed Friday and the deal will be closed in about 45 days after due diligence, SAMAP told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.
SAMAP said it bought all shares of four companies that own New Shopping SA, which in turn is the owner of Paseo Alcorta.
A SAMAP spokesman said Paseo Alcorta was the only asset acquired in the deal.
IRSA is one Argentina's leading real state companies, with interests also in Brazil and Venezuela. Its major shareholder is U.S. financial guru George Soros.
